title: Later computability, proof theory, modal logic, and ordinal analysis
details: Further logic branches should be planned separately: Turing reducibility and degrees, Rice's theorem and the recursion theorem; sequent calculi and cut elimination; intuitionistic logic and negative translations; and modal logic. Ordinal analysis and Goodstein unprovability require their own arithmetic-strength proofs after the arithmetic and incompleteness entries. A proof of Goodstein termination by ordinal descent is not such an unprovability proof.
